represented_population: Store-wide listings, submissions, developer accounts, fee schedules
excluded_population: Independence, realized app revenue, ads/external payments
success_bias: Low success bias; denominator may include dead or noncommercial listings
use_in_report: Best for denominators and definitions; cannot answer income alone.

represented_population: Compelled platform data and market evidence
excluded_population: Often redacted; geography and billing channel narrow
success_bias: Lower disclosure bias; metric can be narrow
tiny_app_exclusion: May exclude ad-funded and external billing apps
use_in_report: CMA’s “no Play Billing revenue” is not “no app revenue.”

represented_population: Apps with integrated subscription infrastructure and observable transactions
excluded_population: Non-subscription apps, zero-revenue apps, apps below minimum thresholds
use_in_report: Strong within-cohort benchmark; poor store-wide denominator.

success_bias: Varies; publication and response bias remain
use_in_report: Useful for structure and historical checks, not current prevalence alone.

represented_population: Apps visible to vendor models, rankings, panels, or SDK detection
excluded_population: Tiny apps and off-store/external revenue; estimation error
success_bias: Can miss low-activity tail; success bias depends on product
use_in_report: Good for relative ranking; not a census of tiny apps.

represented_population: Voluntary listings with linked Stripe, RevenueCat, or Superwall data
excluded_population: Unsellable apps, undisclosed apps, many failures and nonparticipants
revenue_basis: Gross receipts or MRR; costs often absent
use_in_report: High attribution for the listed case; unusable for prevalence without denominator.

excluded_population: Nonrespondents, hobbyists or firms depending recruitment
use_in_report: Can estimate developer-level patterns only when recruitment and unit are clear.

represented_population: A named app or portfolio with narrative context
use_in_report: Best for mechanisms, age, workload, and failure modes; not incidence.
